Source.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/10] Each evaluation included the K-SADS-PL, CGAS, and CES-D. ... [/page/3/Text/11] In addition to the assessments with the clinical evaluator, each adolescent completed the CES-D mid-intervention to assess clinical status.
